First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability using the complement:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 3) & =1-P(X\ge 3) \\  & =1-0.4013 \\  & =0.5987\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 3) & =0.5987 \\ P(Z\le \frac{3-2.5}{\sigma }) & =0.5987 \\ Φ(\frac{0.5}{\sigma }) & =0.5987 \\ \frac{0.5}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.5987)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
\Phi(0.25) = 0.5987 \quad \Rightarrow \quad \Phi^{-1}( 0.5987) = 0.25.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{0.5}{\sigma } & =0.25 \\ \sigma  & =\frac{0.5}{0.25} \\ \sigma  & =2\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sigma }^{2}={2}^{2}=4.\end{aligned}
$$
